  - [Advanced PDF/HTML Templates](chapter_4453550706.md): Advanced PDF/HTML Templates let administrators and users with the Advanced PDF/HTML Templates permission create and control the printed and emailed versions of NetSuite transactions with more flexibility than basic layouts.
